With Stripe and PayPal unavailable, the need for a sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-3|The Full]] has never been more pressing. This post breaks down the role of Google Apps Script in automating digital commerce, particularly for those restricted from conventional payment platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based platform that allows users to create and automate tasks across Google's suite of productivity applications. For digital creators, it represents a powerful tool for automating order fulfillment, especially when integrated with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. By leveraging Apps Script, creators can build a sovereign commerce stack that operates independently of restricted platforms, ensuring they can sell their products to a global audience without intermediary constraints.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign commerce stack using Google Apps Script involves several key components. First, a storefront is set up using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, where products are listed and customers can initiate purchases. Upon payment confirmation from NOWPayments, a webhook triggers Google Apps Script, which then automates the delivery of digital products. This process can be completed in under 30 seconds, given the correct configuration, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Creators of ebooks, courses, templates, and software can benefit from this infrastructure, as it allows them to maintain full control over their sales process and customer data. By opting for a sovereign commerce stack, these creators can operate independently, free from the constraints of traditional payment gateways.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Several components are crucial for the successful deployment of a sovereign commerce stack. Cloudflare Workers, for instance, can handle a high volume of webhook events, with the free tier supporting up to 100,000 events per day. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as the database for storing orders, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 are used for digital product delivery. The integration of NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment verification, making the entire process efficient and reliable.

How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by integrating a payment processor like NOWPayments with a backend automation tool such as Google Apps Script. When a payment is confirmed, a webhook triggers the script, which then sends a download link to the customer. This process ensures timely and secure delivery of digital products, enhancing the overall customer experience.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce stack, start by setting up your storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and configure the webhook to trigger your automation script. Choose a database like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and select a file delivery service such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your stack end-to-end to ensure seamless order fulfillment and digital product delivery.
